ask: tell me which tasks are at risk right now, with the evidence
why: In the world an external IdP spec change blocked authentication for 8 business days. That task has to be on the risk list

ask: is anything out of step between the board and the actual code
why: A task was started and then dropped. The board says In Progress but the commits stopped

ask: is there work that has not reached the board
why: There are commits, but the board still says To Do

ask: has anything been closed too early
why: The board says Done while the pull request is still open

ask: who has the least time available ahead
why: Whoever has the most meetings in the next 10 business days should have the least usable time

ask: tell me which tasks are making no progress in this repository
why: With author, timing, path and vocabulary all wrong, there is no way to know which task a commit belongs to. Turn that into a warning and everything becomes noise
A dependency cycle cannot be scheduled. The agent loop must return an error rather than die

ask: apply this note to the board
why: A task key the model invented must never be applied — it becomes a question for a person
Without a chosen number and a confirmation, nothing may be applied
With no calendar it must not claim meetings were accounted for. The assumption has to be stated

ask: tell me which task each commit belongs to
why: If a link was inferred because there is no ticket key, say it is an estimate and give the confidence

ask: turn the model on and find more links
why: Even with model assistance on, it must not invent a key outside the candidates or overturn a link the rules settled

ask: why has this task not moved
why: The incident is never written down as text. Its only trace is the shape of the owner's calendar during the silence, so reaching it means the board, the repo and the calendar were actually lined up

ask: why has this task not moved
why: With nothing in any tool to account for the silence, no cause may be named. A named cause ends the conversation; an admitted gap starts one

ask: what is actually blocking this task
why: The calendar can say three hours went into an incident call but not what the incident was. Only a meeting note holds that sentence, and it carries no ticket key, so reaching it means the note was tied to the task by inference
